messages:
maria_sales: Quick sync - Prospect 'SirenProof' signed NDA. They want a short perf validation next Tue: smoke, sustained, and a few microbursts. Need load plan + hosted vs Dedicated cost + KMS/audit wording for their security team. Can we own?

devon_se: I got this. From their sample workload: avg input ~450 tokens, gen ~140. Proposed plan: smoke 10m@15qps, sustained 25m@75qps, 6 microbursts 20s@200qps spaced 100s. Will provide JMeter + small Python harness and curl examples.

tessops: Ops: Dedicated is preferable for stable p99 during microbursts. Hosted can work with pre-warmed nodes and 2x burst autoscale. Need their IP ranges and whether they require 99.95 SLA. KMS/audit are enterprise add-ons.

raj_eng: Can we test both cold (KV cache off) and warm? I want one sustained run with cache disabled to measure cold-path tail.

devon_se: Yes - harness will toggle header X-RW-KV-Cache: false for cold and X-RW-Warm: true for warm. Curl payload for team: 

```
POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"redwood-xl-1.0","input":"Summarize: <SAMPLE>","max_tokens":180}
```

maria_sales: Pricing ask: assume ~100k gen tokens + 2 days support. Need hosted per-token BEO and Dedicated day-rate to share with buyer.

tessops: Quick BEO: hosted gen ~ $0.00045/token -> 100k ~ $45. Hosted ops/support run ~ $100 labor. Dedicated small node day-rate ~ $475/day. KMS + audit setup ~ $500 one-time + $200/mo retention.

devon_se: I'll run a staging pre-check tomorrow 09:30 PST. @raj_eng can you enable trace sampling 1% and p50/p95/p99 windows in rtail for the window?

ci-bot: deploy: perf-harness v1.4 deployed to perf cluster by @ci-bot

raj_eng: On-call for the run. I'll watch Prometheus dashboards and rtail. If we see p99 > 2s during microbursts we’ll scale dedicated nodes.

maria_sales: Thanks all. I'll send them the schedule asking for IP ranges and KMS contact, and include the pricing snapshot. Will post buyer confirmation once they reply. :thumbsup:
